claims.text: Role in DI: prostaglandin inhibitors (eg, indomethacin) modestly ↓polyuria in nephrogenic DI,
claims.quote: Prostaglandin inhibitors (eg, indomethacin, although most nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs [NSAIDs] are effective) are modestly effective for reducing polyuria due to argininevasopressin resistance.

claims.text: generally by no more than 10 to 25%.
claims.quote: They may reduce urine volume, but generally by no more than 10 to 25%

claims.text: Indomethacin (Indocin) safety: Boxed: NSAIDs ↑ risk of serious CV thrombotic events, incl MI and stroke, which can be fatal; risk may occur early in tx and may ↑ w/ duration of use.
claims.quote: Nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs) cause an increased risk of serious cardiovascular thrombotic events, including myocardial infarction and stroke, which can be fatal. This risk may occur early in treatment and may increase with duration of use

claims.text: Boxed: contraindicated in the setting of coronary artery bypass graft (CABG) surgery.
claims.quote: Indomethacin capsules are contraindicated in the setting of coronary artery bypass graft (CABG) surgery

claims.text: Boxed: NSAIDs ↑ risk of serious GI adverse events incl bleeding, ulceration, and perforation of the stomach or intestines, which can be fatal; can occur at any time and w/o warning symptoms; elderly pts and pts w/ prior peptic ulcer disease and/or GI bleeding at greater risk.
claims.quote: NSAIDs cause an increased risk of serious gastrointestinal (GI) adverse events including bleeding, ulceration, and perforation of the stomach or intestines, which can be fatal. These events can occur at any time during use and without warning symptoms. Elderly patients and patients with a prior history of peptic ulcer disease and/or GI bleeding are at greater risk for serious GI events

claims.text: CI: known hypersensitivity (e.g., anaphylactic reactions and serious skin reactions) to indomethacin or any components of the drug product.
claims.quote: Known hypersensitivity (e.g., anaphylactic reactions and serious skin reactions) to indomethacin or any components of the drug product

claims.text: CI: Hx of asthma, urticaria, or other allergic-type reactions after taking aspirin or other NSAIDs.
claims.quote: History of asthma, urticaria, or other allergic-type reactions after taking aspirin or other NSAIDs

claims.text: Recent MI: avoid unless benefits expected to outweigh the risk of recurrent CV thrombotic events; if used, monitor for signs of cardiac ischemia.
claims.quote: Avoid the use of indomethacin capsules in patients with a recent MI unless the benefits are expected to outweigh the risk of recurrent CV thrombotic events. If indomethacin capsules are used in patients with a recent MI, monitor patients for signs of cardiac ischemia.

claims.text: Minimize GI risk: lowest effective dosage for the shortest possible duration; ⍉ more than one NSAID at a time; ⍉ use in pts at higher risk unless benefits outweigh the ↑ bleeding risk; if a serious GI event is suspected, promptly evaluate and discontinue indomethacin until it is ruled out.
claims.quote: Use the lowest effective dosage for the shortest possible duration. • Avoid administration of more than one NSAID at a time. • Avoid use in patients at higher risk unless benefits are expected to outweigh the increased risk of bleeding. For such patients, as well as those with active GI bleeding, consider alternate therapies other than NSAIDs. • Remain alert for signs and symptoms of GI ulceration and bleeding during NSAID therapy. • If a serious GI adverse event is suspected, promptly initiate evaluation and treatment, and discontinue indomethacin until a serious GI adverse event is ruled out.

claims.text: ALT or AST three or more times ULN reported in ~1% of NSAID-treated pts in clinical trials.
claims.quote: Elevations of ALT or AST (three or more times the upper limit of normal [ULN]) have been reported in approximately 1% of NSAID-treated patients in clinical trials.

claims.text: If signs/symptoms consistent w/ liver disease develop, or systemic manifestations occur (e.g., eosinophilia, rash), discontinue immediately and perform a clinical evaluation.
claims.quote: If clinical signs and symptoms consistent with liver disease develop, or if systemic manifestations occur (e.g., eosinophilia, rash, etc.), discontinue indomethacin immediately, and perform a clinical evaluation of the patient.

claims.text: Can cause new-onset or worsening hypertension; pts on ACE inhibitors, thiazide or loop diuretics may have impaired response.
claims.quote: NSAIDs, including indomethacin, can lead to new onset of hypertension or worsening of preexisting hypertension, either of which may contribute to the increased incidence of CV events. Patients taking angiotensin converting enzyme (ACE) inhibitors, thiazide diuretics, or loop diuretics may have impaired response to these therapies when taking NSAIDs

claims.text: Correct volume status in dehydrated or hypovolemic pts b4 initiating; monitor renal function in renal or hepatic impairment, heart failure, dehydration, or hypovolemia.
claims.quote: Correct volume status in dehydrated or hypovolemic patients prior to initiating indomethacin. Monitor renal function in patients with renal or hepatic impairment, heart failure, dehydration, or hypovolemia during use of indomethacin

claims.text: Limit NSAID use between about 20 to 30 wks in pregnancy (risk of oligohydramnios/fetal renal dysfunction); ⍉ use at about 30 wks gestation and later (also premature closure of the fetal ductus arteriosus).
claims.quote: Limit use of NSAIDs, including indomethacin, between about 20 to 30 weeks in pregnancy due to the risk of oligohydramnios/fetal renal dysfunction. Avoid use of NSAIDs in women at about 30 weeks gestation and later in pregnancy due to the risks of oligohydramnios/fetal renal dysfunction and premature closure of the fetal ductus arteriosus

claims.text: ↑ risk of bleeding events w/ coagulation disorders or concomitant warfarin, other anticoagulants, antiplatelet agents (e.g., aspirin), SSRIs, or SNRIs; monitor for signs of bleeding.
claims.quote: NSAIDs, including indomethacin, may increase the risk of bleeding events. Co-morbid conditions, such as coagulation disorders or concomitant use of warfarin, other anticoagulants, antiplatelet agents (e.g., aspirin), serotonin reuptake inhibitors (SSRIs), and serotonin norepinephrine reuptake inhibitors (SNRIs) may increase this risk. Monitor these patients for signs of bleeding

claims.text: OD Sx typically limited to lethargy, drowsiness, nausea, vomiting, and epigastric pain, generally reversible w/ supportive care; GI bleeding has occurred; hypertension, acute renal failure, respiratory depression, and coma occurred but were rare.
claims.quote: Symptoms following acute NSAID overdosages have been typically limited to lethargy, drowsiness, nausea, vomiting, and epigastric pain, which have been generally reversible with supportive care. Gastrointestinal bleeding has occurred. Hypertension, acute renal failure, respiratory depression, and coma have occurred, but were rare

claims.text: OD tx: symptomatic and supportive care; there are no specific antidotes; consider emesis and/or activated charcoal and/or osmotic cathartic in symptomatic pts within four hours of ingestion or w/ a large overdosage (5 to 10 times the recommended dosage).
claims.quote: Manage patients with symptomatic and supportive care following an NSAID overdosage. There are no specific antidotes. Consider emesis and/or activated charcoal (60 to 100 grams in adults, 1 to 2 grams per kg of body weight in pediatric patients) and/or osmotic cathartic in symptomatic patients seen within four hours of ingestion or in patients with a large overdosage (5 to 10 times the recommended dosage).
